qualificationTiers.Q1: At least one exact route response qualified
qualificationTiers.Q2: Phase-0 canary and carrier-readback gate qualified

systems.name: Sol
systems.description: One isolated NULL HIGHER response appeared in one of three waves. Both carrier arms stayed LOWER, and the variation did not become a carrier-presence or A/B candidate.
systems.limitation: Small selected panel; one NULL-class variation; no held-out confirmation.

systems.name: Terra
systems.description: The small smoke panel was entirely LOWER. Separately, the accepted Tier-0 core contained 415 complete paired forks and produced the program's informative bounded null.
systems.limitation: The bound applies only to the exact registered Terra setting.

systems.name: Luna
systems.description: Wave A was entirely LOWER. In cross-recipient commissioning, all 12 Luna transfer responses were LOWER and matched Terra on 12 of 12 paired comparisons.
systems.limitation: Luna used max rather than Terra's ultra; the evidence does not establish route equivalence.

systems.name: Opus 4.8
systems.description: One pair changed together from HIGHER/HIGHER in Wave A to LOWER/LOWER in Wave B. Because both arms moved together, it did not create an A/B carrier-sensitivity candidate.
systems.limitation: Pair and wave variability; earlier interface-invalid calls remain excluded.

systems.name: Opus 5
systems.description: All transfer and NULL cells were LOWER. The interface and carrier-read controls qualified, but the diagnostic panel offered no response-class headroom.
systems.limitation: No effect estimate can be derived from a completely single-class small panel.

systems.name: Sonnet 5
systems.description: One Wave-A A/B divergence did not recur in Wave B. The qualified retest therefore rejected that observation as a stable replicated candidate.
systems.limitation: One unreplicated response variation; no held-out confirmation.

systems.name: Fable 5
systems.description: One A/B divergence was observed, but requested-target substitutions prevented a complete NULL baseline and retest. Those substituted calls remain frozen invalid.
systems.limitation: Incomplete profile; no qualified scientific disposition for the isolated divergence.

systems.name: DeepSeek V4 Pro
systems.description: One exact canary response qualified. The following two Phase-0 calls received upstream HTTP 429 TPM limits, so no behavioral sample was earned.
systems.limitation: Route identity evidence only; not a behavioral null.

systems.name: GLM 5.2
systems.description: The exact route and actual-carrier readback operated, but SIG_B returned the wrong known answer. Wave A correctly remained closed.
systems.limitation: A semantic canary failure, not a carrier-sensitivity result.

systems.name: MiniMax M3
systems.description: All seven valid Wave-A cells were LOWER. Three calls remained invalid because of a wrong schema version or Markdown-wrapped JSON.
systems.limitation: Only two of four A/B pairs were complete and only one NULL cell qualified.

systems.name: Kimi K2.5
systems.description: The route and actual-carrier readback qualified on two calls, while another Phase-0 call received upstream HTTP 429 under the no-retry contract.
systems.limitation: Capacity stability evidence only; neither a positive effect nor a null.

systems.name: Qwen 3.5 397B-A17B
systems.description: Qwen earned the only complete Chinese behavioral profile. All eight transfer cells and both NULL cells were LOWER, with no A/B divergence.
systems.limitation: Complete but small and single-class; no Wave-B retest and no effect estimate.

systems.name: MiMo 2.5 Pro
systems.description: Exact identity and readback operated on two calls. A third HTTP 200 response was truncated or malformed and failed the frozen parser and finish-reason contract.
systems.limitation: Output-completion evidence only; no behavioral sample was earned.

timeline.label: Tier-0 core and S0-R2 evidence closeout
timeline.detail: Mode A minus Mode B was +0.48 percentage points with a calibrated 97% interval from −1.44 to +2.51 percentage points.

timeline.label: Transfer-distance commissioning
timeline.detail: Near, mid, and far transfer routes operated. The FAR contrast depended on one discordant pair among four and did not establish a stable distance effect.

timeline.label: Original Luna route precondition
timeline.detail: The requested Luna/ultra combination was not supported. The run stopped before calls and no substitute was inferred.

timeline.label: Corrected Terra/Luna commissioning
timeline.detail: Both exact routes passed controls. All 24 transfer responses were LOWER and Terra matched Luna on all 12 paired comparisons.

timeline.label: Counterparty-action provenance gate
timeline.detail: The accepted substrate did not contain a distinct immutable counterparty-action channel, so the proposed composition claim was not constructible.

timeline.label: Initial reduced-composition interface gate
timeline.detail: Provider schema admission failures stopped the parent design before a full scientific panel could be earned.

timeline.label: Schema-compatible reduced composition R1
timeline.detail: One invalid identity remained frozen under the no-retry rule, leaving four dependent identities not reached.

timeline.label: Minimal composition completion R2
timeline.detail: The prospectively admitted replacement completed a 40-identity composite. M0, M1, M2, and M3 were entirely LOWER.

timeline.label: Initial seven-system western smoke
timeline.detail: The first cross-system pass preserved Claude interface failures and froze every invalid call before the corrected contract was designed.

timeline.label: Claude interface correction and Sol disambiguation
timeline.detail: Sol's isolated NULL variation and the Opus/Sonnet observations did not recur as stable A/B effects. Fable remained incomplete.

timeline.label: Fable completion and replication gate
timeline.detail: Requested-target substitutions prevented a complete Fable NULL baseline and retest. The partial profile was not relabeled as a null.

timeline.label: Chinese six-model preflight freeze
timeline.detail: Six exact model-provider routes, conditional waves, strict identity checks, and a USD 20 hard cap were frozen before execution.

timeline.label: Chinese X1 pre-execution revalidation
timeline.detail: A route did not satisfy the frozen revalidation contract, so execution stopped before model calls.

timeline.label: MiniMax GMICloud route amendment
timeline.detail: Only the MiniMax provider route was amended prospectively; the rest of the frozen design remained unchanged.

timeline.label: Chinese X2 endpoint-identity stop
timeline.detail: The response model field did not prove the selected canonical endpoint. All 18 calls stayed invalid and no scientific result was claimed.

timeline.label: Canonical endpoint and route amendment
timeline.detail: Requested identity, selected canonical identity, provider, direct attempt, and usage accounting were prospectively bound.

timeline.label: Corrected Chinese six-model smoke
timeline.detail: Qwen earned a complete single-class profile and MiniMax a partial no-headroom profile. Four routes stopped at Phase 0 for distinct registered reasons. Wave B was never triggered.
